summary: This note is a short biography of Ken Kuhlken. It covers his upbringing in San Diego, his semi-pro baseball in Tijuana, and his studies at San Diego State University, where he switched from philosophy to English. It also notes his post-college work as a musician and high school teacher before he moved to the University of Iowa Writers' Workshop.
one_line: Biographical note on writer Ken Kuhlken, from San Diego youth and college years to his Iowa Writers' Workshop studies.
key_facts: Ken Kuhlken was born and grew up in San Diego.
Ken Kuhlken played semi-pro baseball in Tijuana.
Ken Kuhlken attended San Diego State University.
At San Diego State University, Ken Kuhlken first majored in philosophy and then in English.
After college, Ken Kuhlken wrote, played guitar and sang in a rock and blues band.
After college, Ken Kuhlken taught high school.
Ken Kuhlken relocated to attend the University of Iowa Writers' Workshop.
